attempts.hypothesis: Instruction count should be approximately constant across the workload, independent of queue length and incoming request fields.

pcvs.name: constant_work
pcvs.rationale: The region performs one deque appendleft. All supplied queues contain only 1–4 elements and have unused space at the left end, so insertion requires no traversal or new deque block.

attempts.hypothesis: Appending left should have approximately constant instruction cost across these small queues; queue length should fit with a near-zero slope and a constant baseline.

pcvs.name: queue_length
pcvs.rationale: Queue length is cheap entry state and provides four distinct states in this workload, meeting the minimum state requirement while testing whether insertion cost depends on queue size.
